api/src/routers/github.py.name: GitHub connection
api/src/routers/github.py.description: Connects the workspace to a GitHub repository so code and settings can be saved, shared and kept in step.

api/src/routers/health.py.name: Health checks
api/src/routers/health.py.description: Reports whether the platform and its database, cache and file storage are working, for monitoring tools.

api/src/routers/home.py.name: Home screen
api/src/routers/home.py.description: Builds each person's home screen with their shortcuts and collections, and remembers their preferences.

api/src/routers/hooks.py.name: Incoming messages
api/src/routers/hooks.py.description: Receives messages that outside services send when something happens, and passes them to the event system.

api/src/routers/identities.py.name: Service identities
api/src/routers/identities.py.description: Manages the accounts used for work no person started, such as each organization's default.

api/src/routers/integrations.py.name: Outside service connections
api/src/routers/integrations.py.description: Sets up connections to outside services, their sign-in, their logos and which organization uses which account.

api/src/routers/jobs.py.name: Background job status
api/src/routers/jobs.py.description: Lets screens check how a long background task is going and collect its result.

api/src/routers/knowledge_sources.py.name: Knowledge library
api/src/routers/knowledge_sources.py.description: Organizes the documents the AI can search, grouped by topic, with editing and removal.

api/src/routers/kubernetes.py.name: Background computing
api/src/routers/kubernetes.py.description: Controls how much computing power is available for background work and which jobs run in isolation.

api/src/routers/llm_config.py.name: Search settings
api/src/routers/llm_config.py.description: Chooses the AI service that makes text searchable by meaning, and rebuilds the search index when it changes.

GET /api/github/config.name: GitHub settings
GET /api/github/config.description: Shows which repository the workspace is connected to.

GET /api/github/status.name: Source control status
GET /api/github/status.description: Shows whether the workspace is connected and whether there are unsaved changes.

GET /api/github/repo-status.name: Unsaved changes check
GET /api/github/repo-status.description: Quickly reports whether local files differ from what is saved, so the command-line tool can warn before pushing.

POST /api/github/validate.name: Connect a GitHub account
POST /api/github/validate.description: Checks a GitHub access pass, saves it, and lists the repositories it can reach.

GET /api/github/repositories.name: GitHub repositories
GET /api/github/repositories.description: Lists the repositories your saved GitHub account can use.

GET /api/github/branches.name: Repository branches
GET /api/github/branches.description: Lists the branches in a chosen repository.

POST /api/github/create-repository.name: Create a repository
POST /api/github/create-repository.description: Makes a new GitHub repository for this workspace.

POST /api/github/disconnect.name: Disconnect GitHub
POST /api/github/disconnect.description: Removes the saved GitHub connection from the workspace.

GET /api/github/commits.name: Commit history
GET /api/github/commits.description: Lists past saved versions with who made them and when, a page at a time.

POST /api/github/connect/preview.name: Compare before connecting
POST /api/github/connect/preview.description: Shows how the workspace differs from a remote branch before either is changed.

POST /api/github/connect.name: Connect to a branch
POST /api/github/connect.description: Links the workspace to a branch using a comparison you already saw.

POST /api/github/fetch.name: Fetch latest from GitHub
POST /api/github/fetch.description: Downloads the newest changes from GitHub without merging them.

POST /api/github/commit.name: Save a version
POST /api/github/commit.description: Records the workspace's changes as a saved version with a message.

POST /api/github/sync.name: Sync with GitHub
POST /api/github/sync.description: Pulls the latest changes, sends yours up, and refreshes the platform's settings from the repository.

POST /api/github/abort-merge.name: Cancel a merge
POST /api/github/abort-merge.description: Stops an in-progress merge and returns the files to how they were.

POST /api/github/changes.name: Check changed files
POST /api/github/changes.description: Lists which files have changed since the last saved version.

POST /api/github/resolve.name: Resolve a conflict
POST /api/github/resolve.description: Marks a conflicting file as settled so the merge can finish.

POST /api/github/diff.name: Compare file versions
POST /api/github/diff.description: Shows exactly what changed in a file.

POST /api/github/discard.name: Discard changes
POST /api/github/discard.description: Throws away unsaved changes to chosen files.

GET /health.name: Is it up
GET /health.description: Answers whether the platform is running, for monitoring tools.

GET /health/live.name: Is it alive
GET /health/live.description: Confirms the main server is responding at all.

GET /health/ready.name: Ready for traffic
GET /health/ready.description: Confirms the platform can serve requests and reach what it depends on.

GET /health/detailed.name: Component health
GET /health/detailed.description: Shows whether the database, cache and file storage are each working.

GET /api/home.name: Home screen
GET /api/home.description: Builds your home screen with shortcuts, collections and recent items.

POST /api/home/collections.name: New collection
POST /api/home/collections.description: Creates a named group of shortcuts on the home screen.

PUT /api/home/collections/{collection_id.name: Rename a collection
PUT /api/home/collections/{collection_id.description: Changes a home screen collection's name or contents.

DELETE /api/home/collections/{collection.name: Delete a collection
DELETE /api/home/collections/{collection.description: Removes a collection from the home screen.

PUT /api/home/preferences/{resource_key}.name: Remember a preference
PUT /api/home/preferences/{resource_key}.description: Saves how you like one part of the home screen to look.

GET /api/hooks/health.name: Incoming message health
GET /api/hooks/health.description: Confirms the platform is ready to receive messages from outside services.

GET /api/hooks/{source_id}.name: Verify message address
GET /api/hooks/{source_id}.description: Answers an outside service's setup check so it will start sending messages here.

POST /api/hooks/{source_id}.name: Receive external message
POST /api/hooks/{source_id}.description: Accepts a message from an outside service and queues it for the event system.

PUT /api/hooks/{source_id}.name: Receive external update
PUT /api/hooks/{source_id}.description: Accepts an update message from a service that announces changes this way.

PATCH /api/hooks/{source_id}.name: Receive external change
PATCH /api/hooks/{source_id}.description: Accepts a change message from a service that reports edits this way.

DELETE /api/hooks/{source_id}.name: Receive external removal
DELETE /api/hooks/{source_id}.description: Accepts a removal message from a service that reports deletions this way.

GET /api/identities.name: Service identities
GET /api/identities.description: Lists the accounts used for automated work, including each organization's default.

POST /api/identities.name: Add a service identity
POST /api/identities.description: Creates a named account for automated work.

PATCH /api/identities/{identity_id}.name: Rename a service identity
PATCH /api/identities/{identity_id}.description: Changes a service identity's display name.

DELETE /api/identities/{identity_id}.name: Delete a service identity
DELETE /api/identities/{identity_id}.description: Removes a service identity that is no longer needed.

POST /api/integrations.name: Add a connection
POST /api/integrations.description: Sets up a new outside service the platform can talk to.

GET /api/integrations.name: Connections list
GET /api/integrations.description: Lists the outside services the platform is connected to.

GET /api/integrations/{integration_id}.name: Connection details
GET /api/integrations/{integration_id}.description: Shows one connection's settings, sign-in details and organization links.

GET /api/integrations/by-name/{name}.name: Connection by name
GET /api/integrations/by-name/{name}.description: Finds a connection using the short name people know it by.

PUT /api/integrations/{integration_id}.name: Edit a connection
PUT /api/integrations/{integration_id}.description: Changes a connection's settings, name or sign-in details.

DELETE /api/integrations/{integration_id.name: Remove a connection
DELETE /api/integrations/{integration_id.description: Retires a connection so workflows can no longer use it.

POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.name: Upload connection logo
POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.description: Sets the small square picture shown for the service.

DELETE /api/integrations/{integration_id.name: Remove connection logo
DELETE /api/integrations/{integration_id.description: Clears the service's picture so the default is shown.

PUT /api/integrations/{integration_id}/c.name: Save connection defaults
PUT /api/integrations/{integration_id}/c.description: Saves settings used for the connection unless an organization overrides them.

GET /api/integrations/{integration_id}/c.name: Show connection defaults
GET /api/integrations/{integration_id}/c.description: Shows the settings used for the connection unless an organization overrides them.

POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.name: Link an organization
POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.description: Connects one organization to its own account with the outside service.

GET /api/integrations/{integration_id}/m.name: Organization links
GET /api/integrations/{integration_id}/m.description: Lists which organizations are linked to which outside accounts.

GET /api/integrations/{integration_id}/m.name: Link details
GET /api/integrations/{integration_id}/m.description: Shows one organization's link to its outside account.

GET /api/integrations/{integration_id}/m.name: Organization link
GET /api/integrations/{integration_id}/m.description: Finds the outside account linked to a particular organization.

PUT /api/integrations/{integration_id}/m.name: Edit an organization link
PUT /api/integrations/{integration_id}/m.description: Changes an organization's outside account details or settings.

POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.name: Link many organizations
POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.description: Creates or updates several organization links at once.

DELETE /api/integrations/{integration_id.name: Remove an organization link
DELETE /api/integrations/{integration_id.description: Unlinks an organization from its outside account.

POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.name: Sign in to a service
POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.description: Starts the sign-in that lets one organization's outside account be used.

POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.name: Disconnect an organization account
POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.description: Removes the saved sign-in for one organization's outside account.

POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.name: Renew an organization sign-in
POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.description: Gets a fresh sign-in pass for an organization's outside account.

GET /api/integrations/{integration_id}/o.name: Sign-in method
GET /api/integrations/{integration_id}/o.description: Shows how the connection signs in to the outside service.

GET /api/integrations/{integration_id}/o.name: Get a sign-in link
GET /api/integrations/{integration_id}/o.description: Creates the link that starts signing in to the outside service.

PATCH /api/integrations/{integration_id}.name: Choose account identifier
PATCH /api/integrations/{integration_id}.description: Decides where the outside service's account identifier comes from.

DELETE /api/integrations/{integration_id.name: Reset account identifier
DELETE /api/integrations/{integration_id.description: Returns the account identifier choice to its default.

POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.name: Test a connection
POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.description: Checks that the platform can still reach and use the outside service.

POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.name: Build ready-made code
POST /api/integrations/{integration_id}/.description: Creates ready-made code for talking to a service described in an API document.

GET /api/jobs/{job_id}.name: Background job progress
GET /api/jobs/{job_id}.description: Shows how a long-running task is going and its result when finished.

GET /api/knowledge-sources.name: Knowledge topics
GET /api/knowledge-sources.description: Lists the topics documents are filed under, with how much each holds.

GET /api/knowledge-sources/documents.name: All knowledge documents
GET /api/knowledge-sources/documents.description: Lists documents across every topic, with filters for finding one.

PATCH /api/knowledge-sources/documents/s.name: Change document sharing
PATCH /api/knowledge-sources/documents/s.description: Moves several documents to a different sharing scope at once.

GET /api/knowledge-sources/{namespace}/d.name: Documents in a topic
GET /api/knowledge-sources/{namespace}/d.description: Lists the documents filed under one topic.

POST /api/knowledge-sources/{namespace}/.name: Add a knowledge document
POST /api/knowledge-sources/{namespace}/.description: Saves a document under a topic and makes it searchable.

PUT /api/knowledge-sources/{namespace}/d.name: Update a knowledge document
PUT /api/knowledge-sources/{namespace}/d.description: Saves changes to a document and refreshes how it is found in search.

DELETE /api/knowledge-sources/{namespace.name: Delete a knowledge document
DELETE /api/knowledge-sources/{namespace.description: Removes a document and every part of it from search.

DELETE /api/knowledge-sources/{namespace.name: Delete a knowledge topic
DELETE /api/knowledge-sources/{namespace.description: Deletes a topic and every document in it.

GET /api/admin/kubernetes/status.name: Computing status
GET /api/admin/kubernetes/status.description: Shows whether the platform's background computing is healthy and how busy it is.

GET /api/admin/kubernetes/execution.name: Background work settings
GET /api/admin/kubernetes/execution.description: Shows how background work is set to run and how much computing it may use.

PUT /api/admin/kubernetes/execution.name: Change background work settings
PUT /api/admin/kubernetes/execution.description: Adjusts how background work runs and how much computing it may use.

PUT /api/admin/kubernetes/policy.name: Change isolation rules
PUT /api/admin/kubernetes/policy.description: Decides which jobs run in their own isolated space instead of sharing.

GET /api/admin/llm/embedding-config.name: Search service settings
GET /api/admin/llm/embedding-config.description: Shows which AI service turns text into something searchable by meaning.

POST /api/admin/llm/embedding-config.name: Choose a search service
POST /api/admin/llm/embedding-config.description: Sets the AI service used to make documents searchable by meaning.

DELETE /api/admin/llm/embedding-config.name: Reset search service
DELETE /api/admin/llm/embedding-config.description: Returns search to the platform's shared AI service choice.

POST /api/admin/llm/embedding-reindex.name: Rebuild the search index
POST /api/admin/llm/embedding-reindex.description: Re-reads every stored document so search works with the newly chosen service.

POST /api/admin/llm/embedding-test.name: Check search service
POST /api/admin/llm/embedding-test.description: Tests the sign-in details for a search service and lists the models it offers.
